wc:minerva-tabs.summary: Tabs with a tablist, roving focus and automatic or manual activation.
wc:minerva-tabs.description: Accessible tabs (WAI-ARIA tabs pattern, `<Tabs>` / `<TabList>` of React) with line / enclosed / soft / pills variants, semantic colors and horizontal or vertical orientation. Tabs (`<minerva-tab>`) and panels (`<minerva-tab-panel>`) are light DOM children paired by `value`; the element renders the `role="tablist"` around the tabs (they go to the `tab` slot automatically) and wires `aria-selected` / `aria-controls` / `aria-labelledby` with ids in the light DOM. Arrow keys (per orientation and direction), Home and End move focus among the enabled tabs (core roving focus); with `activation-mode="automatic"` the focused tab is selected, with `"manual"` only Enter / Space / click select.

wc:minerva-tab-panel.description: The `role="tabpanel"` content of the tab with the same `value` (`<TabPanel>` of React). Inactive panels: React's `<TabPanel>` unmounts them by default and keeps them in the DOM with `hidden` only with `forceMount`. Light DOM children belong to the page, so a custom element cannot unmount them: regular children behave like React's `forceMount` (the panel is `hidden`, its content stays in the DOM, keeps its state and its form fields are still submitted). For React's default semantics, put the content in a `<template>` child: it is stamped while the panel is active and removed when it becomes inactive (state reset, elements disconnected, nothing submitted); add `force-mount` to keep it mounted (hidden) while inactive, like `forceMount`.

examples.title: Inactive panels: mounted or not
examples.description: React's <TabPanel> unmounts inactive panels by default and keeps them (hidden) with forceMount. Light DOM children belong to the page, so <minerva-tab-panel> cannot unmount them: regular children behave like forceMount (hidden, state kept, form fields still submitted). Put the content in a <template> for React's default (created while active, removed afterwards), and add force-mount to keep it mounted while hidden.

colors.title: Colors and manual activation
colors.description: color sets the group color; a Tab color keeps that tab tinted while inactive. With activationMode="manual", focus moves without selecting, so the parent can confirm the change in onChange.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: orientation="vertical" stacks the tabs; ArrowUp / ArrowDown move between them.
